title: GitHub says individuals and orgs have invested $100M+ in open source maintainers and projects via GitHub Sponsors since 2019, with $10M in the past five months (Stephanie Lincoln/The GitHub Blog)
summary: Stephanie Lincoln / The GitHub Blog: GitHub says individuals and orgs have invested $100M+ in open source maintainers and projects via GitHub Sponsors since 2019, with $10M in the past five months — Celebrating $100 million contributed by the community to the people who build and sustain open source every day.
